hardConstraints.content: Never change the signature of an exported function.
Never force-push or rewrite published history.

taskContract.title: Add rate limiting to the public API
taskContract.behavior: Requests above 100 per minute per API key get HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
acceptanceCriteria: {Description:Requests above the limit receive 429 VerificationRef:go test ./ratelimit/...}
{Description:The limit is configurable per key VerificationRef:}
taskContract.verificationSpec: go test ./... passes and golangci-lint is clean
taskContract.outcomeProtocol: Finish your final message with exactly one outcome marker, as the very last thing you write: <agentkit-outcome>{"schemaVersion":1,"outcome":"NAME"}</agentkit-outcome> where NAME is one of taskContract.allowedOutcomes, spelled exactly as listed. Write the marker once: do not end any earlier message with one. The attempt fails if the marker is missing, repeated, malformed, or names an outcome that is not listed.

resources.content: Run go vet and go test before reporting done.
Prefer small functions; wrap errors with %w.
The ratelimit package owns all quota state.

messages.content: Please keep the public handler signatures unchanged.
Use <agentkit-outcome> only as the final line & quote nothing: "x" é
